# CCSE (Canadian Center of Science and Education)

> > CCSE is a Canadian academic publisher providing open-access, peer-reviewed scholarly journals and research support services for educators and researchers worldwide.

The Canadian Center of Science and Education operates a multi-disciplinary portfolio of academic journals covering topics from network and communication technologies to education and scientific research. CCSE is indexed in major databases including CNKI Scholar, DBLP, and Elektronische Zeitschriftenbibliothek, and offers free books programs for developing country research libraries.

## Main Portal

- [CCSE Homepage](https://www.ccsenet.org): Main portal for the Canadian Center of Science and Education, providing access to scholarly journals and research support services
- [CCSE Home (Alternate)](https://ccsenet.org): Primary homepage for CCSE academic publisher serving educators worldwide
- [CCSE Web Portal](http://web.ccsenet.org/): Canadian Center of Science and Education web interface and main access point

## Journals Directory

- [Journals Catalog](https://ccsenet.org/journal/index.php): Complete directory of CCSE's open-access peer-reviewed publications across multiple disciplines
- [Network and Communication Technologies Journal](http://nct.ccsenet.org/): Peer-reviewed open-access journal focused on networking, communications, and related technologies

## Research Support

- [Free Books Program](https://ccsenet.org/home/index.php/research/books): CCSE Library initiative providing free books to research libraries in developing countries
